1436-5261-7170.easyPrerequisites:
Call to Glory is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
1436-5261-7170.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
1436-5261-7170.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Living Brain.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Call to Glory without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Call to Glory, untapping all creatures you control and giving Samurai you control +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

3899-4067-5003-7848.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four graveyards that each have seven or more cards in them.
3899-4067-5003-7848.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing The Master of Lake-town.
When The Master of Lake-town dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Master of Lake-town trigger, drawing a card for each graveyard that has seven or more cards in it.
Holding priority, activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the mana-producing permanent
Repeat steps 4 and 5 until you have {4} or more available.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return The Master of Lake-town from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.
3899-4067-5003-7848.notes: If your graveyard has six cards in it, you can count that as one of the graveyards with seven cards in it, as The Master of Lake-town will count as the seventh card. If the permanent taps for more than {1}, there can be less graveyards with seven cards in them.

1912-2043-4715-7824.description:
Activate Urza by paying {4}, creating two token copies of Prized Statue that are 1/1 Soldiers in addition to their other types.
When the Prized Statue tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.

1987-2239-2427.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that taps to produce at least {U}
1987-2239-2427.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Ardent Elementalist.
When Ardent Elementalist enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2239-2427.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

1056-3649-5361.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least three opponents.
You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1056-3649-5361.notablePrerequisites:
Each opponent controls at least three nontoken creatures.
Opponents cannot block creatures you control.
1056-3649-5361.description:
Activate Araumi by tapping it and exiling three cards from your graveyard, ensuring not to exile Auton Soldier, giving Auton Soldier encore until end of turn.
Activate Auton Soldier's encore ability by paying {4}{U}{U} and exiling it from your graveyard, creating a token copy of it with haste for each opponent you have. Choose to have each Auton Soldier enter as nonlegendary copies of Etrata with myriad.
Declare each Auton Soldier as an attacker, each attacking a different opponent.
Each Auton Soldier's myriad ability triggers, creating a token copy of it tapped and attacking each other opponent.
Deal combat damage using all the Auton Soldiers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the first Auton Soldier trigger, exiling a creature an opponent controls with a hit counter on it and causing that opponent to lose the game if they have three or more cards with hit counters on them in exile.
Repeat step 6 as needed for the remaining triggers.

1661-2113-3713-5078.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

997-6529-7084.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

141-3967-5260.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-3967-5260.description:
Cast Entering by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Entering.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Entering, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Entering copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-3967-5260.notes: You can cast Breaking and Entering fused together to also get infinite mill and self-mill.

475-1274-3197-4321.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-1274-3197-4321.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-4593-6291-6720.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
2034-4593-6291-6720.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

1563-2351-6460-6791.easyPrerequisites:
You control a token.
It is an opponent's turn.
1563-2351-6460-6791.description:
Activate Hardened Tactician by paying {1} and sacrificing a token.
If you sacrificed a Tentacle, The Watcher's second ability triggers if the creature token was a Tentacle, untapping a Kraken and putting a stun counter on up to one nonland permanent.
Resolve the Hardened Tactician ability, causing you to draw a card.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate the Tentacle by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

1563-1753-2457-4094.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
1563-1753-2457-4094.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

1563-2351-3480-6460.easyPrerequisites:
You control a token.
It is an opponent's turn.
1563-2351-3480-6460.description:
Activate Hardened Tactician by paying {1} and sacrificing a token.
If you sacrificed a Tentacle, The Watcher's second ability triggers if the creature token was a Tentacle, untapping a Kraken and putting a stun counter on up to one nonland permanent.
Resolve the Hardened Tactician ability, causing you to draw a card.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate the Tentacle by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

2034-5189-5332.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
2034-5189-5332.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
Carmen's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

277-1170-1418-2733-5954.description:
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying {U}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping them.
Resolve the Shimmering Wings spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

116-4639-5475.notablePrerequisites: Forensic Researcher and Kiora's Follower do not have summoning sickness.
116-4639-5475.description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Forensic Researcher triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
Kiora's Follower triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.

914-1322-3036.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1322-3036.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Wizard Mentor by paying {2}{U}.
Activate Wizard Mentor by tapping it, returning it and Dockside Extortionist to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
If opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

1453-1636-3490.notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}.
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it.
1453-1636-3490.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield, which enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Intruder Alarm and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate a mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token that enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Repeat from step 2.

643-1636-2416.notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}.
Maskwood Nexus does not have summoning sickness.
643-1636-2416.description:
Cast Rise and Shine by paying {1}{U}, causing Maskwood Nexus to become a 0/0 artifact creature, then putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate any number of mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Maskwood Nexus by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a 2/2 Shapeshifter creature token.
When the Shapeshifter enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {4}, this combo nets infinite mana.

1509-3259-5220.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card that has haste on top of your library.
Breath of Fury attached to a nontoken creature you control that has haste.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1509-3259-5220.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker.
Doors of Durin triggers, causing you to scry 2, ensuring to leave the creature card with haste on top of your library, then revealing the creature card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature Doors of Durin returned, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat each combat phase.

2146-3532-4842-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Chasm Skulker triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

100-2034-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Elgaud Inquisitor, adding {C}{C}.
When Elgaud Inquisitor dies, it and Nim Deathmantle triggers.
Resolve the Elgaud Inquisitor trigger, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Elgaud Inquisitor from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

617-4306-4331.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to blue is at least five.
617-4306-4331.description:
Activate Nyx Lotus's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Voltaic Key by paying {1}.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Voltaic Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1516-1872-2882.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Composite Golem.
1516-1872-2882.description:
Cast Departed Soulkeeper from your graveyard by paying it's disturb cost of {1}{W}{U}.
Departed Soulkeeper enters the battlefield as a copy of Composite Golem.
Activate Departed Soulkeeper by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Repeat.

1636-3590-4474.notablePrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Warchanter Skald.
Warchanter Skald does not have summoning sickness.
1636-3590-4474.description:
Activate Warchanter Skald using the Paradise Mantle ability by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Warchanter Skald triggers, creating a 2/1 Dwarf Berserker token.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

413-671-1981.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and by sacrificing any other creature you control.
Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Blasting Station and Daxos trigger.
Resolve the Daxos trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

803-3413-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Arcane Adaptation, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.
